page.overview:
Who is Embereck?

The Ash Warlord Embereck was an Elemental planeswalker native to Dominaria. He was said to be one of that world's most powerful planeswalkers. He specialized in red mana.

Embereck fought Ravidel over the resurfaced Golgothian Sylex shortly after the Ice Age in the ruins of a city on Terisiare. Some sort of bargain was struck, and Ravidel left in possession of the Sylex. Later Embereck helped create the council of Minorad. He left this council after they decided not to interfere with Ravidel.

In the unpublished comic Planeswalkers War, Embereck is killed by Ravidel.
